sources.binary: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list DS Tuc A and HD 222259B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 6387058411482257536 and 6387058411482257280), 237 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 7.2e-8: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.
